description: Figure 7 is a bar chart that displays the number of questions, out of a total of 40, for which Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generated by GPT3 contained at least one factual error. The chart compares three different methods: NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRCoT QA. The horizontal axis lists the different prompt demonstration and evaluation dataset combinations, labeled as 2W→HQ, MQ→HQ, HQ→2W, MQ→2W, HQ→MQ, and 2W→MQ. The vertical axis represents the count of questions with at least one factual error, scaled from 0 to 100. For each of the six combinations, three bars are shown, corresponding to the three methods. The bar for NoR QA is colored yellow, OneR QA is red, and IRCoT QA is blue. The values on top of the bars indicate the specific count for each method. For example, for the 2W→HQ combination, NoR QA has 25.8, OneR QA has 49.4, and IRCoT QA has 59.6. The chart visually demonstrates that the number of questions with factual errors is lowest for IRCoT QA and highest for NoR QA across all tested combinations, supporting the caption's claim that factual errors follow the order IRCoT < OneR < NoR.
